defects.title: Qualification and eligibility bypass
defects.red_observation: REVOKED / UNQUALIFIED / PENDING results all remained eligible_for_semantic_statistics==True; PENDING + ELIGIBLE publication escaped the validator entirely (violations==[])
defects.root_cause: single eligibility function with no qualification dimension; validator qualification rule covered only UNQUALIFIED/REVOKED; eligibility consulted a caller-provided enum at best
defects.repair: five eligibility authorities (diagnostics / semantic statistics / business statistics / formal publication / reward); formal authorities require an actual QualificationCertificate from a CertificateStore bound by scope AND dataset/parser/evaluator identity against record provenance; certificate is the authority, explicit record REVOKED always blocks; no store -> fail closed; structured EligibilityDecision reasons
defects.regression: test_contract_validator.TestEligibilityAuthorities (9 tests incl. revoked-certificate and identity-mismatch fail-closed)

defects.title: Unsafe Boolean coercion in legacy conversion
defects.red_observation: from_legacy_boolean('False') -> CORRECT (string truthiness inversion), None -> INCORRECT, 0/1/[]/[1] -> coerced verdicts, unknown failure class 'TOTALLY_NEW_CLASS' -> ordinary INCORRECT
defects.root_cause: bool(x) coercion of the verdict field; unknown failure classes fell through to the ordinary branch
defects.repair: type(x) is bool enforced in from_legacy_boolean AND EvaluationResult.evaluated(); complete legacy-schema validation (contradictory metadata: replay_error/transport_error alongside True verdict, http_ok alongside transport error; unknown failure classes raise LegacyContractError); adapter maps contract errors to a separately classified NOT_EVALUABLE record; to_legacy_boolean validates the complete record first
defects.regression: test_legacy_and_n02rr_adapter (non-boolean table, contradiction table, unknown-class, export-validates); state-space malformed injections 44/44

defects.title: Illegal evaluation state combinations escaping
defects.red_observation: MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID+CORRECT, NOT_EVALUABLE+ELIGIBLE, PENDING+ELIGIBLE, business-PASS+EVALUATOR_ERROR, business-PASS+safety-NOT_VERIFIED all escaped (violations==[]); string/int enum substitution accepted with zero violations
defects.root_cause: validator rule coverage gaps; dataclass accepted arbitrary types for enum fields
defects.repair: new validator rules (5 classes) + strict runtime type validation in EvaluationResult.__post_init__ raising ContractTypeError; cognitive/business invariants separated (business rules fire only for business verdicts != NOT_APPLICABLE)
defects.regression: systematic state-space battery: exhaustive 4 blocks (9,312 combinations) against an INDEPENDENTLY authored 24-rule model (never calls the validator under test): 0 escapes, 0 false rejections, all 24 invariants exercised, 44/44 malformed type injections rejected; tests/ij_eval_assurance/test_state_space.py makes it permanent

defects.title: Evidence trusted by default; provenance unverified
defects.red_observation: default EvidenceIntegrity.VERIFIED - a record constructed without evidence got VERIFIED trust; provenance completeness == several nonempty strings
defects.root_cause: default trust instead of default skepticism
defects.repair: default evidence UNVERIFIED; VerifiedEvidence envelope (versioned) produced ONLY by verify_evidence() after actual checks (artifact sha256 match, strict schema validation, trial identity, evaluator identity; basis field distinguishes direct vs qualified-loader transfer); validator cross-checks envelope identity against record provenance so caller dicts cannot overwrite verified identity; decisive verdicts require VERIFIED evidence + envelope
defects.regression: test_contract_validator (envelope rules), state-space block 4 (R10-R15), adapter without-sha stays UNVERIFIED

defects.title: No formal Analyzer boundary
defects.red_observation: no qualified aggregation path existed; the historical analyzer reads Booleans directly (EA00 R3: injected corpus 870/2184 -> 871/2186)
defects.repair: src/eval_assurance/statistics/boundary.py aggregate_semantic: consumes ONLY typed EvaluationResult records (no Boolean/dict entry point - such inputs are quarantined); validates every record through the central validator; classifies qualified / not_evaluable / quarantined / canary; formal publication fail-closed without certificate; historical analyzer marked DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY in its docstring (behavior unchanged, sealed artifacts preserved)
defects.regression: test_boundary.TestEA00CorruptionRegression against the ACTUAL aggregation entry point: sealed 2,184 + 2 injected -> 870 correct preserved, 2 NOT_EVALUABLE reported separately, 871/2186 structurally unreachable, formal publication BLOCKED_NO_CERTIFICATE_BOUND without cert and ALLOWED with cert, sealed corpus file hash unchanged

defects.title: Publication process gate exit-status masking
defects.red_observation: live reproduction: direct publish_check exit 1 (BLOCKED) vs shell-pipelined exit 0 - pipe_masks_block==true
defects.root_cause: shell pipeline returns the LAST command's status; operator discipline is not a control
defects.repair: scripts/ij_eval_assurance/pubgate.py: argv-list subprocess (no shell, no pipeline), exit code captured directly, verdict parsed from finding counts (never exit code alone), malformed/truncated output fails closed, staged-content identity bound before/after the check (post-check change fails), auditable receipt per run, commit subcommand refuses while BLOCKED
defects.regression: test_pubgate: 6 injected failure modes (nonzero exit, zero-exit-with-findings, truncated, empty, mid-check staging change, missing/corrupt/incomplete receipt) all fail closed; pipe-masking regression pinned live

residual_limitations: CertificateStore is in-memory + optional JSON persistence; the complete certificate lifecycle (EA17) including signed receipts, scope hierarchies and CI enforcement is future work - formal eligibility therefore fails closed, which is the intended posture until then

verify_evidence basis='n02rr_validated_loader_transfer' transfers a verification result already performed by the qualified N02RR loader rather than re-hashing bytes; direct re-verification is used when the envelope is built at load time

state-space coverage is exhaustive over the four declared blocks (9,312 combos) plus 44 malformed-type injections, not over the full cross-product of all dimensions (approx 3M); higher-order interactions outside the blocks are covered by the validator's rule-at-a-time structure and the independent model agreement
pubgate does not install git hooks or remote branch protection (out of authorized scope without permission); it is the reproducible local gate entry point and receipt authority
gate_status: GRANTED (scope: evaluation-contract invariants EA-D01..EA-D06; NOT a claim that the assurance system as a whole is qualified)
